entries.title: Proverbs 8:1
segments: ¶Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding give forth her voice?

entries.title: Proverbs 8:2
segments: On the top of high places by the way, at the cross-paths she taketh her stand.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:3
segments: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors, she crieth aloud.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:4
segments: Unto you, men, I call, and my voice is to the sons of man:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:5
segments: O ye simple, understand prudence; and ye foolish, understand sense.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:6
segments: Hear, for I will speak excellent things, and the opening of my lips shall be right things.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:7
segments: For my palate shall meditate truth, and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:8
segments: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing tortuous or perverse in them.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:9
segments: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:10
segments: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:11
segments: for wisdom is better than rubies, and all the things that may be desired are not equal to it.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:12
segments: ¶I wisdom dwell [with] prudence, and find the knowledge [which cometh] of reflection.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:13
segments: The fear of Jehovah is to hate evil; pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth do I hate.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:14
segments: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am intelligence; I have strength.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:15
segments: By me kings reign, and rulers make just decrees;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:16
segments: by me princes rule, and nobles, all the judges of the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:17
segments: I love those that love me; and they that seek me early shall find me.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:18
segments: Riches and honour are with me; durable wealth and righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:19
segments: My fruit is better than fine gold, yea, than pure gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:20
segments: I walk in the path of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:21
segments: that I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasuries.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:22
segments: ¶Jehovah possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:23
segments: I was set up from eternity, from the beginning, before the earth was.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:24
segments: When there were no depths, I was brought forth, when there were no fountains abounding with water.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:25
segments: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:26
segments: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:27
segments: When he prepared the heavens I was there; when he ordained the circle upon the face of the deep;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:28
segments: when he established the skies above, when the fountains of the deep became strong;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:29
segments: when he imposed on the sea his decree that the waters should not pass his commandment, when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:30
segments: then I was by him [his] nursling, and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:31
segments: rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth, and my delights [were] with the sons of men.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:32
segments: ¶And now, sons, hearken unto me, and blessed are they that keep my ways:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:33
segments: hear instruction and be wise, and refuse it not.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:34
segments: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:35
segments: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and obtaineth favour of Jehovah;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:36
segments: but he that sinneth against me doeth violence to his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
